cases.query: the Google paper that introduced MapReduce

criteria: The original research paper document itself

requirements.text: The document itself is the Google paper that introduced MapReduce
requirements.evidence: The document text or title shows it is that paper.

candidates.title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters

page.title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
page.text: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters. Jeffrey Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat, jeff@google.com, sanjay@google.com, Google, Inc. Abstract: MapReduce is a programming model and an associated implementation for processing and generating large data sets. Users specify a map function that processes a key/value pair to generate a set of intermediate key/value pairs, and a reduce function that merges all intermediate values associated with the same intermediate key. To appear in OSDI 2004.
